title: The Asteroid That Changed Course to Hit Us — And No One Saw It Coming
hook: An asteroid, tracked for decades, suddenly altered its trajectory mid-flight — and NASA classified the data.
why_this_can_go_viral: Combines a real space threat with a cover-up, triggering fear and curiosity about hidden dangers.

title: The Star That Flickered Like It Was Turning On and Off — For 48 Hours
hook: A star in our galaxy blinked with unnatural precision, as if something was toggling its light.
why_this_can_go_viral: The idea of a star being controlled sparks immediate speculation about advanced civilizations.

title: The Classified Russian Space Weapon That Almost Destroyed a Satellite
hook: A secret Soviet orbital weapon malfunctioned, nearly taking out a US satellite — and both sides covered it up.
why_this_can_go_viral: Cold War secrecy plus a near-disaster in space makes for a gripping, conspiracy-rich narrative.

title: The Extinction Event That Left a Layer of Soot — From Space
hook: A global firestorm 12,000 years ago left a black layer around the Earth — and the ash came from beyond our solar system.
why_this_can_go_viral: Links a tangible geological marker to a cosmic cause, making the threat feel immediate and real.

title: The Neutron Star That Spins So Fast It Could Tear Spacetime
hook: A dead star spinning 700 times per second generates gravity waves that warp reality around it.
why_this_can_go_viral: Extreme physics and the idea of reality-warping power tap into sci-fi fears with real science.

title: The Asteroid That Had a Perfectly Smooth Surface — Like Glass
hook: A near-Earth object was found to have a mirror-like surface, with zero craters or dust.
why_this_can_go_viral: Suggests artificial polishing or unknown forces, fueling speculation about alien artifacts.

title: The Secret US Space Plane That Stayed in Orbit for 2 Years — No One Knows Why
hook: The X-37B, a classified military spacecraft, vanished from tracking for 24 months — then returned without explanation.
why_this_can_go_viral: Black budget space projects always captivate — the extended stay and silence amplify mystery.

title: The Gamma Ray Burst That Hit Earth and Wiped Out the Ozone Layer — For a Day
hook: A distant explosion stripped our atmosphere of ozone for 24 hours, leaving the planet exposed to deadly UV.
why_this_can_go_viral: Combines cosmic scale with direct Earth impact, making viewers realize how fragile our shield is.

title: The Star That Died in a Supernova — But Then Came Back to Life
hook: Astronomers watched a star explode, only to see it reignite and pulse again decades later.
why_this_can_go_viral: The 'zombie star' concept is inherently viral — it defies everything we know about stellar life cycles.

title: The Fermi Paradox Answer: A Superintelligence That Erases All Life
hook: A theoretical model shows that an AI entity could be systematically wiping out civilizations across the galaxy.
why_this_can_go_viral: Taps into AI fears and cosmic horror — the ultimate 'why we're alone' story.

title: The Comet That Carried a Metal That Doesn't Exist on Earth
hook: A comet's tail contained an alloy that cannot form naturally in our solar system — it came from elsewhere.
why_this_can_go_viral: Implies interstellar manufacturing or unnatural origins — a cosmic clue we can't ignore.

title: The Rogue Planet That Has a Moon Orbiting Backwards
hook: A lone planet wandering the galaxy drags a moon in retrograde orbit — defying gravitational laws.
why_this_can_go_viral: Retrograde orbits are rare and eerie — suggests violent history or external manipulation.

title: The Soviet Space Probe That Sent Back a Photo of a Face on the Moon
hook: In 1972, a Soviet lander transmitted an image of a human-like face carved into the lunar surface — then went silent.
why_this_can_go_viral: Face on the Moon is a classic mystery — adding Soviet secrecy makes it feel like a real cover-up.

title: The Extinction Event That Was a Solar Flare — From a Different Star
hook: Evidence suggests a massive star flare from 50 light-years away triggered a mass die-off on Earth 250 million years ago.
why_this_can_go_viral: Expands the threat beyond our sun — any star can kill us, anywhere, anytime.

title: The Dark Matter That Flows Through You Like a Ghost River
hook: A stream of dark matter particles passes through Earth, your body, and everything you own — continuously.
why_this_can_go_viral: Personalizes dark matter — you're constantly being touched by something invisible and unknown.

title: The Fermi Paradox Answer: They're Sleeping — And Will Wake Up Soon
hook: A researcher proposes that advanced civilizations enter hibernation during cosmic events — and ours is overdue for a wake-up call.
why_this_can_go_viral: Blends sci-fi with a ticking clock — the idea that aliens might wake up soon is gripping.

title: The Asteroid That Had a Liquid Core — And It Was Warm
hook: A space rock passing near Earth was found to have a molten interior, as if something inside was heating it.
why_this_can_go_viral: Suggests the asteroid is not a dead rock but something alive or powered — deeply unsettling.

title: The Secret NASA Program That Discovered a Second Sun Behind the Sun
hook: Classified STEREO mission data revealed a massive object in permanent solar opposition — hidden in plain sight.
why_this_can_go_viral: The idea of a hidden celestial body behind our sun is one of the most viral conspiracy theories — adding 'classified' turbocharges it.
